comment: Manifest of spawnable entities. The browser can't list a folder, so this is the authoritative roster (and its ORDER fixes the binary wire ids — see EntityRegistry). Each entry is a PATH relative to this folder, WITHOUT the .json; the def's id is the basename (so 'mobs/hornet' → id 'hornet'). Add an entry here AND drop a matching <path>.json to add an entity. mobs/ = creatures, petals/ = orbiting petals, player at the root.
